Sends custom headers on same-host crawl requests

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { customHeaders: { "Accept-Language": "en-US", "X-Custom-Header": "test-value" }, maxDepth: 1, respectRobotsTxt: false, subdomainHeaderAllowlist: ["Accept-Language"] };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages.length);
}

void main();
```
